description: Model mapped to lmdbA whose on* scripts also use lmdbB (a separate LMDB environment) and lmdbA2 (a second adapter id on lmdbA's environment).

Order.description: Default processing writes lmdbA. onAddObject and onDeleteObject also write lmdbB.

auditCount.description: Read from lmdbB while lmdbA's read of this object is still open.

Note.description: Script only: every on* stores in lmdbB, though the model's mappedAdapterId is lmdbA.
Note.onAddObject:
const r: object = add_object('lmdbB', 'NoteRow', current::object, current::objectId);
return r.objectId;

OrderAliasRead.description: Reads lmdbA2 while lmdbA's read of this object is still open.

OrderAliasWrite.description: Writes lmdbA2 while lmdbA's read of this object is still open.

OrderSelfNote.description: onAddObject and onDeleteObject also write the mapped adapter, lmdbA, inside the model's own lmdbA transaction.

noteCount.description: Read lmdbA again while the model's read of this object from lmdbA is open.
